[opaque block] and good to meet you Johnny
Many thanks for making the connection.
We'd be delighted to set up a call and share more of our work and our perspective on the business model of
disinformation. We'd be very interested to hear more about how USAID is thinking about the challenge also.
Perhaps we can arrange a videocall in the next few weeks?
I am copying in Jo Jenks, another of our management team who will join the call from our side. And also Anna who can
offer a range of suggested times for a video call. As some of the GDI team are Europe based we will propose a few
options in US morning/European afternoon.
Looking forward to continuing the conversation
best wishes and thanks again for making the introduction
Clare
On Fri, Jun 10, 2022 at 12:58 PM [opaque block] [opaque block] > wrote:
Danny, Clare,
I'm writing to introduce my friend Johnny Walsh, DAA for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance at USAID.
Johnny's team is building out a portfolio around countering disinformation. I think it would be incredibly useful for them
to get a bit of a lay-of-the-land on how commercial interests are driving the spread of disinformation. At a minimum they
should be aware of the capabilities you have and hear your theory of the case for how to reduce the pernicious spread
of political disinformation.
Johnny,
As I mentioned GDI is the best organization I know working on the commercial, for-profit side of the disinformatio
challenge. I think you and your team will benefit greatly from their perspective
All the best to you all,
[opaque block]
